title: Family Relation Tree #1
statement: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
explanation: A is female child of C, who is child of D. Hence A is Granddaughter of D.

title: Family Relation Tree #2
statement: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "His mother's only daughter is my mother." How is the woman related to the man?
explanation: His mother's only daughter is his sister. The woman is the daughter of his sister, hence his Niece.

title: Family Relation Tree #3
statement: Introducing a man, a lady said, "The father of his brother is the only son of my grandfather." How is the lady related to the man?
explanation: Father of his brother = his father. Only son of grandfather = father. Hence lady and man have same father -> Sister.

title: Family Relation Tree #4
statement: P is the brother of Q and R. S is R's mother. T is P's father. Which of the following statements cannot be definitely true?
explanation: The gender of Q is not explicitly given, so Q could be daughter or son.

title: Family Relation Tree #5
statement: A is father of C and D is son of B. E is brother of A. If C is sister of D, how is B related to E?
explanation: A is father of C and D. Since D is son of B, B is mother of C and D (wife of A). E is brother of A, so B is Sister-in-law of E.

title: Categorical Syllogism #1
statement:
Statements: (1) All cats are felines. (2) All felines are mammals.
Conclusions:
I. All cats are mammals.
II. Some mammals are cats.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

explanation: Since Cats ⊂ Felines ⊂ Mammals, all cats are mammals (I) and some mammals are cats (II) both logically hold.
